purpose: Screen prediction-connected Mamba2AutoCon against its exact AutoCon control on PEMS07 H12 before any multi-dataset confirmation.
research_question: Does routing the AutoCon representation into the Mamba2 forecast improve validation accuracy without invalidating the low-latency resource profile?
selection_history: The prediction-connected branch was added after a contract audit showed that the legacy Mamba2AutoCon representation was auxiliary-only. Its ReZero gate is initialized at zero and was verified by unit tests and a synchronized RTX 5090 D probe.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory screen. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: This screen cannot establish cross-dataset, long-horizon, graph-aware, or publication-level superiority.
prelaunch_gates: verify PEMS07 fingerprint and M feature geometry
pair the exact lambda-zero Mamba2AutoCon control with the prediction-connected treatment
retain the synchronized RTX 5090 D resource probe as the efficiency evidence
stop if treatment is more than 1% worse than the control mean

phases.name: pems07_h12_mamba2_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact Mamba2AutoCon control with auxiliary AutoCon objective and no prediction fusion.

phases.name: pems07_h12_mamba2_autocon_fusion
phases.purpose: Mamba2AutoCon with the zero-initialized prediction-connected AutoCon representation residual.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: prediction-connected fusion versus exact Mamba2AutoCon control
comparison_contract.resource_contract: Report synchronized GPU latency, parameters and peak memory for both branches and the frozen baselines.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, cross-dataset, long-horizon, or publication claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, seeds, or budget after launch.
If fusion exceeds the exact control mean by more than 1%, stop and do not promote.
Do not release test metrics from this screen.
